name: valid_assigned_error
description: Specific error is assigned before being wrapped in Err.

name: valid_qualified
description: Qualified base, error, and Result constructors.

name: wrong_base
description: Specific error does not subtype NotFoundError.

name: generic_result
description: Reachable missing-style outcome uses generic NotFoundError.

name: raises_specific
description: Specific error is raised rather than returned in Err.

name: bare_specific
description: Specific error is returned without Err.

name: dead_specific
description: Specific Err construction follows an unconditional return.

name: token_decoy
description: Imports and strings do not define or return the specific error.

name: specific_plus_generic
description: A specific Err cannot compensate for another reachable generic Err.
